ideas.title: Uncovering Patterns of Misconduct within DHS
ideas.description: Investigate potential patterns of misconduct or lack of transparency within the Department of Homeland Security, particularly in their response to high-profile incidents like the Alex Pretti shooting.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of DHS protocols and responses
questions: What are the root causes of DHS's response to the Pretti shooting?
Are there similar instances of misconduct or lack of transparency?
searches: lack of transparency in government agencies
ideas.insight: This story could reveal systemic issues within DHS and potentially lead to reforms or greater oversight.
